body:
## Context
Issue #645: `packages/gate-fuzzing/bin/gate-fuzzing.mjs` and `packages/gate-fuzzing/README.md` document and accept `--canary-budget`, `--behavioral-witness`, and `--triage`, but all three flags are completely inert (parsed into `values` and never read again; `--canary-budget` is not even validated as a number). Operators who pass these flags in CI believe canary potency rounds, behavioral witnessing, or triage annotations are active when nothing runs.

## Scope
- `packages/gate-fuzzing/bin/gate-fuzzing.mjs`
- `packages/gate-fuzzing/README.md`
- `packages/gate-fuzzing/test/bin.test.mjs`

## Changes Required
1. Remove `--canary-budget`, `--behavioral-witness`, and `--triage` from the `--help` usage/options text in `packages/gate-fuzzing/bin/gate-fuzzing.mjs` and from the usage/options table in `packages/gate-fuzzing/README.md`.
2. In `packages/gate-fuzzing/bin/gate-fuzzing.mjs`, omit the default on `canary-budget` and fail closed via `opError` (exit 1) with an explicit message if `--canary-budget`, `--behavioral-witness`, or `--triage` is passed.
3. Add CLI tests in `packages/gate-fuzzing/test/bin.test.mjs` verifying that passing `--canary-budget`, `--behavioral-witness`, or `--triage` exits 1 with a clear error message and that `--help` no longer advertises them.

## Acceptance Criteria
- Passing `--canary-budget`, `--behavioral-witness`, or `--triage` to `gate-fuzzing` exits 1 with an explicit error.
- `--help` and `README.md` no longer advertise the inert flags.
- Verify: `node --test packages/gate-fuzzing/test/bin.test.mjs`
title: gate-fuzzing: reject unimplemented --canary-budget, --behavioral-witness, and --triage flags (#645)
